description: Defines the google_breakpad::ElfCoreDump class for handling ELF core dump files, including methods for accessing headers, program headers, notes, and data copying.

classes.name: ElfCoreDump
classes.description: Encapsulates an ELF core dump file mapped into memory, providing access to headers, program headers, notes, and data copying.

classes.name: ElfCoreDump::Note
classes.description: Represents a note in the ELF core dump, providing methods to access note header, type, name, description, and the next note.

methods.name: ElfCoreDump(const MemoryRange& content)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the core dump with provided content.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the core dump contains a valid ELF header.

methods.name: GetHeader
methods.description: Returns the ELF header if valid.

methods.name: GetFirstProgramHeaderOfType
methods.description: Returns the first program header of a specific type.

methods.name: GetProgramHeaderCount
methods.description: Returns the number of program headers.

methods.name: CopyData
methods.description: Copies data from the core dump at a specified virtual address.

methods.name: GetFirstNote
methods.description: Returns the first note in the core dump.
